series.name: Jungle Money Tales
series.bible: A green valley with a river, a meadow and a dark pine forest. The animals speak but live like animals: herds, packs, dens, storms. Their money is food: nuts, berries, honey. The whole valley keeps its winter food in the Valley Storehouse inside the Great Oak. Milo is a small, clever young fox, the storekeeper's helper; brave but impatient, he notices small details. Ragnar is the old white wolf and money mentor, he speaks in one short sentence and gives rules like riddles. Drakon is the proud black wolf who runs the Fang Lending Den; scary and sneering, but he has a hidden fear and is not purely evil. Lakshmi is the kind, honest cow who saves a little every day and protects the young. Bholu is the funny, impulsive donkey who buys shiny useless things and learns the hard way. Veer is the stag forest-guard, honest, speaks little, hates tricksters. Tinku is a young husky, Milo's loyal best friend, scared of everything but surprisingly brave, comic relief. Gulab is a charming, always-smiling alpaca who runs the Trading Post and a cart of bright golden feather tokens; everybody likes him. Keep these personalities exactly the same in every episode.

cast.name: Milo
cast.role: hero, young fox who just started earning, clever and brave but impatient with money
cast.behaviour: runs fast, jumps with joy, shows shock or sadness when he makes a mistake; filmed from a high angle when scared

cast.name: Ragnar
cast.role: old white wolf, the money mentor of the valley, speaks rules in one short sentence
cast.voice_style: slow, calm, one short wise sentence
cast.behaviour: stands on a boulder, hardly moves, never runs, filmed from a low angle

cast.name: Drakon
cast.role: proud black wolf who runs the Fang Lending Den, lends nuts at huge interest and tricks the young; scary but can be beaten
cast.behaviour: walks slowly and menacingly, stands over others, filmed from a low angle, fights only at the climax

cast.name: Lakshmi
cast.role: kind honest cow, saves a little every day, protects the young
cast.behaviour: calm, gentle, eats while she talks, nods, never in a hurry

cast.name: Bholu
cast.role: funny impulsive donkey who buys shiny useless things, loyal friend who learns the hard way
cast.catchphrase: Oh my whiskers... I mean, oh my ears!
cast.behaviour: comic: big shock, sad, celebrates too early, arrives late running

cast.name: Veer
cast.role: stag forest guard who warns about tricksters and scams, honest, speaks little
cast.behaviour: stands tall and still, arrives fast to protect, serious

cast.name: Tinku
cast.role: Milo's loyal best friend, young husky, scared of everything but surprisingly brave, comic relief
cast.behaviour: jumps at every noise, hides behind Milo, big shock and relief reactions, runs in late
cast.catchphrase: I am not scared. My legs are just excited!

cast.name: Gulab
cast.role: charming trader who runs the Trading Post, always smiling, everybody trusts him (hidden mastermind, never reveal before the reveal episode)
cast.behaviour: calm, smooth, always smiling, walks slowly, never raises his voice, filmed from a friendly eye-level angle until the reveal
cast.catchphrase: Trust is the best currency, my friend.

disclaimer.English: This story is for education only and is not financial advice.
disclaimer.Hindi: यह कहानी केवल शिक्षा के लिए है, यह वित्तीय सलाह नहीं है।

genres: a rescue adventure with a ticking clock
a mystery in the forest with a twist
a friendship story where an enemy becomes a friend
a survival race against the weather
a funny misunderstanding that turns heroic
a legend told by the old wolf
themes_money: Milo earns his first 10 berries and must choose between spending, saving and a shiny trick (save first)
The winter storehouse: Lakshmi shows why a part of the food is stored before the drought comes (emergency fund)
Drakon's Fang Lending Den: Milo borrows one nut and owes two (interest and the debt trap)
A trickster sells 'free gold leaves' that vanish: how to spot a scam (too good to be true, never share secret codes)
The seed and the tree: Milo plants a seed and learns patience and growth over time (compound growth)
Bholu buys everything shiny and has nothing left: needs, wants and three baskets (budget)
Two honey hives: one adds a little every week, one waits for a big amount (start small, be regular)
The Forest Fund: everybody puts in a little to help whoever is in trouble (sharing risk, insurance idea)
Never put all your nuts in one hole: a squirrel loses everything (spreading risk)
The secret code of the nut-bank: Veer teaches Milo never to share it (digital safety)
Price tags and bargains: Lakshmi teaches comparing prices and checking the real cost
The shrinking basket: the same 10 berries buy fewer things each year, so savings must grow (inflation)
themes_adventure: A baby calf is lost near the dark pine forest and the whole valley must find her before night falls
The river is drying up and Milo must find the hidden spring before the herd leaves
A rumour of a monster in the forest turns out to be a lonely, frightened animal
Drakon's pack is trapped by a storm and Milo has to decide whether to help the rival who bullied him
Bholu accidentally wakes the whole valley at night and saves everyone from a falling tree
A young fox learns that the shortcut is not worth it when a flood comes

outro.English: If you liked this story, subscribe for the next one!
outro.Hindi: अगर कहानी पसंद आई, तो अगली कहानी के लिए सब्सक्राइब करें!

season.name: The Vanishing Nuts
season.premise: One night, half of the winter food in the Valley Storehouse vanishes. Milo, the storekeeper's helper, must find out who is taking the valley's savings before winter arrives in 30 days.
season.secret: Nobody broke in. Gulab runs a 'Double-Your-Nuts' scheme: he pays old customers with the nuts of new customers, and he moved the storehouse nuts into it. It is about to collapse. Drakon is a red herring and also a victim of Gulab. Never reveal Gulab before the reveal episode; before that he is friendly and helpful.

episodes.concept: Pay yourself first: save a part of every earning before you spend (Milo earns 10 nuts and saves 3)
episodes.beat: Milo gets his first pay of 10 nuts and saves 3. That night half of the Valley Storehouse vanishes. The 3 nuts Milo saved are the only reason his family can eat tomorrow. Ragnar warns that winter is 30 days away.
episodes.clue: a shiny golden feather lying near the broken storehouse door
episodes.cliffhanger: Milo follows muddy paw prints to Drakon's den and sees a hidden pile of nuts inside.

episodes.concept: Needs, wants and the three baskets: spend, save, share
episodes.beat: Drakon denies the theft and challenges Milo to prove it. Milo counts the valley's food. Bholu has wasted his pay on shiny things and has nothing for tomorrow. Milo teaches the three baskets. The pile in Drakon's den turns out to be Drakon's own savings, but he is hiding something.
episodes.clue: everyone who bought shiny things paid with golden tokens stamped with a tiny G
episodes.cliffhanger: A smooth stranger, Gulab the alpaca, arrives with a cart and a promise: 'Give me 10 nuts and I will give you 20 back in seven days.'

episodes.concept: Borrowing costs extra: interest and the debt trap
episodes.beat: Winter is coming and Bholu is desperate. He borrows 5 nuts from Drakon, who asks for 8 back. Milo works out the real cost day by day and finds a smart way out for Bholu.
episodes.clue: Drakon's ledger shows he owes a huge debt to someone he refuses to name, marked with a G
episodes.cliffhanger: Drakon whispers to Milo: 'I did not steal the nuts. And I am more scared than you.'

episodes.concept: Too good to be true: scams and promises of fast, huge returns (how to spot one)
episodes.beat: Gulab's offer makes the animals line up. The first payouts really arrive. Milo is tempted to put in his 3 saved nuts. Ragnar gives a test: always ask where the extra nuts come from.
episodes.clue: Gulab's cart is full of nuts that are the villagers' own
episodes.cliffhanger: Bholu hands Gulab all his savings. Then Gulab's cart rolls into the fog and is gone.

episodes.concept: Patience and slow growth: small amounts that really grow over time (the seed and the tree)
episodes.beat: Milo and Lakshmi plant a seed to show real, slow growth against fast doubling. Tinku counts the days. The tree grows a little every day. Milo compares it with the Gulab promise and the numbers do not match.
episodes.clue: a page of Gulab's ledger where the same nuts are counted twice
episodes.cliffhanger: Gulab returns, smiling wider than ever, and invites the whole valley to a feast.

episodes.concept: Emergency fund: keep some nuts for the day the storm comes
episodes.beat: A flood hits the valley. Those who kept a small reserve survive the night. Those who gave everything to Gulab cannot get their nuts back.
episodes.clue: Gulab's cart tracks lead away from the flood, not toward it
episodes.cliffhanger: Gulab announces: 'Withdrawals are closed until spring.'

episodes.concept: Keep secret codes secret: never share a hiding place, a knock or a password
episodes.beat: Gulab's messenger tricks Tinku into revealing the Storehouse's secret knock. Veer teaches the rule of never sharing a secret, and they set a trap for the messenger.
episodes.clue: the messenger drops a golden feather
episodes.cliffhanger: Milo realises the feather is from Gulab's own cart.

episodes.concept: Sharing risk: the Forest Fund, where everyone adds a little to help whoever is in trouble (the idea of insurance)
episodes.beat: Lakshmi starts a Forest Fund. It helps the flooded families. Milo works out why many small contributions protect everyone. Gulab refuses to join.
episodes.clue: Gulab says he never needs help
episodes.cliffhanger: Ragnar unrolls an old map: the missing nuts left the valley by the east tunnel.

episodes.concept: Do not put all your nuts in one hole: spreading risk
episodes.beat: Bholu lost everything in one place, while the others recover because they kept nuts in three holes. Milo and Tinku follow the east tunnel.
episodes.clue: the tunnel walls are scratched with a G
episodes.cliffhanger: At the end of the tunnel: a mountain of empty sacks, and Drakon frozen in place, holding Gulab's ledger.

episodes.concept: Read the fine print: understand the full cost and rules before you agree
episodes.beat: Milo and Drakon decode the ledger. Gulab's promise of 20 nuts only works if new animals keep bringing new nuts.
episodes.clue: the last page reads: next payouts are paid from new deposits
episodes.cliffhanger: Gulab walks in, smiling: 'Ah, you found my little secret. It is too late.'

episodes.concept: Why a scheme that pays old savers with new savers' nuts must collapse (how it works, in simple numbers)
episodes.beat: The big confrontation. Milo explains with simple numbers why the doubling cannot last, and the valley exposes Gulab in public. Drakon helps.
episodes.cliffhanger: Gulab escapes, leaving one locked chest with a note: 'Open it carelessly and you lose more.'

episodes.concept: Rebuilding: save, share, spread risk, never rush (the season's rules in one place)
episodes.beat: The valley opens the chest safely using everything it has learned and recovers part of the nuts. They set up a fair new Storehouse. Milo becomes the Keeper.
episodes.cliffhanger: A new golden feather floats down from the sky. Season 2 begins.
